description: This file defines classes for a WebBridge SDK, including a JSON-RPC client, service, and service manager, facilitating WebSocket communication and remote procedure calls within a web-based bridge environment.

classes.name: JsonRpcClient
classes.description: Handles JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket, managing requests, responses, and incoming messages.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a remote service with methods that can be registered and invoked via JSON-RPC.

classes.name: ServiceManager
classes.description: Manages multiple services, handles WebSocket connections, and facilitates service registration and communication.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the WebSocket connection for the JSON-RPC client or service.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request with specified method and parameters, returning a promise.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends a notification message over WebSocket.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Serializes and sends a message over WebSocket.

methods.name: _onIncomingMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages, resolving associated promises.

methods.name: registerMethod
methods.description: Registers a method with a specific name and version in the Service.

methods.name: _callMethodByName
methods.description: Invokes a registered method by name with provided parameters.

methods.name: registerService
methods.description: Registers a service with the ServiceManager and initiates connection.

methods.name: _connectService
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to a specific service endpoint.

methods.name: _controllerActivateService
methods.description: Sends a request to activate a service via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: _sendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message over WebSocket.

methods.name: _controllerCloneService
methods.description: Clones a service via JSON-RPC request.
